audit.whatIsWrong: The last two rows gave both item stages to Heimerdinger while whys[5], whys[6], spikes[2], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say you take over completely once you have an item. Rows 3 and 4 also disagreed with the mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit on heimerdinger__vladimir settled the chart as Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Vladimir / Vladimir / Vladimir and applied it, which also fits 52.16%: he zones you until you can pool-dive at 6, then it is yours.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped as matched win[N] + phases[N].side pairs with ratings rescaled, and whys[3] rewritten so the prose says level 4-5 is still his.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the grenade — the ability the whole page tells you to track — was never timed.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11 seconds at every rank, Hextech Micro-Rockets 11s down to 7s, and UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70. A flat 11s is the single most useful number here because it never shortens: the dive window after he throws it is the same at level 4 as at level 16.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was described as a flat stun, which is wrong — it stuns only enemies hit directly and merely slows those caught nearby. Hextech Affinity's move speed near his turrets was missing, and the turret name was abbreviated to 'H-28G Turret'.
audit.why: Riot's text: the grenade deals damage 'as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units'; the passive grants 'Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger'. Clipping the edge instead of eating the centre is the difference between a dive that lands and one that dies, and the speed boost is why he escapes into the nest.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and spikes[0].text; the turret's full name used in early.

edits.before: By 4-5 the lane is even as you gather stacks to punish him.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his turret wall still zones you while you gather stacks.

edits.before: Heimerdinger locks the lane with his H-28G Turrets (Q) and Hextech Micro-Rockets (W), zoning you off CS and chunking every approach — his turret wall out-ranges your Transfusion and denies you free farm.
edits.after: Heimerdinger locks the lane with H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q) and Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) every 11s, zoning you off CS. Hextech Affinity also speeds him up near his turrets, so he simply outruns you back into the nest.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash before his turrets are set, but from 2-3 Heimerdinger takes over — his H-28G Turret (Q) plus Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) build a poke wall that out-ranges your Transfusion and denies you the wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash before his turrets are set, but from 2-3 Heimerdinger takes over — H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q) plus Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) build a poke wall that out-ranges your 600-range Transfusion and denies you the wave.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) is 11s flat and stuns only on a direct hit — clipping the edge just slows you.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Direct hit stuns, the edge only slows — 11s flat, so dive after it.

edits.before: That is Heimerdinger's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! empowers his next spell — a boosted grenade lands before your dive does.

notes: The packet suspect name 'Electron Storm Grenade' is a FALSE POSITIVE — the page writes the full 'CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade'. The mirror and the packet disagree on rows 3 and 4; I followed the mirror, which is already applied. Left unstated, as the mirror did: whether Sanguine Pool's untargetability removes a grenade stun that has already applied. Riot's text does not say, and it is not a cleanse.
